usedFor: Shopify holds your shoppers, and Webengage adds them as users when “New Customer” runs “Add User”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer” in Shopify, then “Add User” in Webengage
bestTemplate.why: Every new Shopify customer becomes a Webengage user, ready for the campaigns you run there.

watchOut: “New Customer” fires only for new Shopify customers, so existing ones need a one-off import into Webengage.
